features.f: Petite and slender with narrow shoulders, a soft heart-shaped face, big eyes and a small chin. No human ears: a pair of smooth horns grows from the sides of the head where the ears would be and sweeps back and down to about the jaw like small crescents (the chosen face sets the shape: curved crescent, flat pointed blade, broad scaly fin, or a round ram's curl). Horns, scales and tail are ivory white for Raen and glossy black for Xaela; small scale plates make a tiny crest between the brows, line the cheekbones and jaw under the horns and form a scaly collar round the throat, and a long, thick, scaly tail tapering to a point hangs from the lower back to about the calves.
features.m: Huge, broad-shouldered and heavily muscled (deep chest, thick arms, long legs), with a long angular face, heavy brow and strong jaw; nearly half again as tall as the dainty women. Big ridged horns grow from the sides of the head where the ears would be and curl back then forward around the face toward the jaw (the face sets the shape: ram's curl, jagged flaring blades, or long hooks reaching below the chin, some with darker tips). Ivory-white horns, scales and tail for Raen, black for Xaela; thick scale plates cover the jaw and chin like a beard and run down the neck, with a crest on the brow and patches on the cheekbones, and a long, heavy, scaly tail reaches about the ankles.

f.desc: An off-the-shoulder, knee-length charcoal-grey dress with a white folded band across the shoulders, spiky silver scale-plate pauldrons on both shoulders, a round silver brooch with a little red bow at the chest and a brown strip down the front; a dark woven belt with a big silver buckle laced with red X stitches and a hanging charm of red beads and white-and-green feathers, and a white pleated underskirt with brown X stitches peeking out on one side under the ragged, pointed hem. A brown fingerless half-glove wraps her left forearm (a thin bracelet on the right wrist), and knee-high dark olive-brown wrapped boots with folded ragged tops, small silver claw spikes at the sides and open toes finish the look.

m.desc: A bare-midriff warrior look: a torn white crop top crossed by a dark studded leather strap with a red cross emblem and a round buckle, one spiked silver pauldron on his right shoulder with a dark band round that upper arm, and dark grey wrapped arm guards with ragged cuffs (a red cord at the right wrist). Below, wide baggy olive-green trousers with ragged ankle hems, a broad black corset belt laced with silver criss-cross, a torn rust-orange cloth hanging over the hips and a dark panel with a spiky silver ornament down one leg, over open brown sandals with dark ankle wraps.

notes: Hairs: XIVAPI v2 CharaMakeType rows 20/21 (Raen m/f) and 22/23 (Xaela m/f), Gender 0 = male. The Hairstyle menu (Lobby 234) holds 47 entries for each gender, identical for both clans, so there are no clan-only extras. Every listed CharaMakeCustomize row has IsPurchasable=false and no HintItem/UnlockLink, while the rows left out of the menu (e.g. 1573 Pulse, 1577 Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, 1582 Ponytails) are Modern Aesthetics or event unlocks, so all 47 are free at creation. Race-own styles are f01-f12 and m01-m12 (FeatureID 1-12; Au Ra have no 51+ extras); f13-f47 and m13-m47 (FeatureID 102-178, shared:true) are the shared all-race styles the creator also offers free. For parity with a Lalafell set built only from race-own styles (1-13 + 51-53), take f01-f12 / m01-m12. Shared FeatureIDs are not the same cut across genders (e.g. 103 is a side ponytail for women, a short spiky tousle for men). Icons: front three-quarter view only, hair rendered grey, and every icon wears face 1's horns (women: small ivory crescents; men: a big ivory ram's curl wrapping forward along the jaw), so backs of tails, buns and braids are partly inferred. In all icons the horns grow out under the hair at ear level: short cuts stop above them, long hair falls behind them, and side locks or braids hang in front of them. Accessory colours are as the icons show them (some may tint with the hair or highlight colour in game); the black crescent pieces on m02/m08 are read as hair ornaments, not extra horns. Horns: Au Ra pick horns through the Face menu (4 faces per gender, each with its own horn shape and scale pattern); the Tail Shape menu offers 4 tails (plain tapering, one with a side spike, a broad finned ridge, a forked claw tip) plus a tail-length slider. Raen and Xaela face, tail and hair icons are byte-identical, so the white (Raen) vs black (Xaela) horn, scale and tail colour comes from the wiki and lore, not from the icons. Attire: CharaMakeType Equipment[0] is model 257 v2 (m) / 258 v2 (f) for both clans; an Item search on those ModelMain values returns the Auri set, the creator outfit for Raen and Xaela alike. Colours from the ffxivcollection renders (undyed). The Auri Pantalettes are hidden under the gown, so they are not described. Heights: from the vhpg.com height chart (min 146.0 / avg 152.2 / max 158.5 cm for women, 203.0 / 209.8 / 216.9 cm for men; same for both clans); scale = average / 90 cm. Skins: the creator's own swatch (interface) colours from human.cmp via the xivdyetools data, checked against a creator screenshot of the Au Ra palettes (pudgy-puk tumblr); rendered skin in game looks a little lighter and softer. Palettes differ by clan and gender: Raen women run peach, tan, olive, pale pink and blue-grey; Raen men are ruddier (rose to deep red-brown, olive, mauve-grey) with no very pale tones; Xaela run lavender-grey to navy, pale ash to dark slate, and tan to dark brown. The 8 swatches per gender mix both clans. Thai race name: เอาร่า is a transliteration; Thai players also write ออร่า.
